mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (name, region, city, district, address, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{region}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{isActive})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM store WHERE 1=1
AND region = #{region}
AND ( city = #{subRegion} OR ((city IS NULL OR city = '') AND district = #{subRegion}) )
AND is_active = 1 AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW() AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW())
AND is_active = 1 AND open_at > NOW() AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW())
AND is_active = 1 AND open_at IS NULL AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW())
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at <= NOW()
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at > NOW()
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE(closed_at) < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND closed_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY
open_at ASC
closed_at ASC
closed_at DESC
id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE 1=1
AND region = #{region}
AND ( city = #{subRegion} OR ((city IS NULL OR city = '') AND district = #{subRegion}) )
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at > NOW()
AND is_active = 1 AND closed_at IS NULL AND open_at IS NULL
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at <= NOW()
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at > NOW()
AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE(closed_at) < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND closed_at <= NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at <= NOW() AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operating,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND open_at > NOW() AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scheduled,
SUM(CASE WHEN closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at <= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed,
SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 AND open_at IS NULL AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactive
FROM store
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(closed_at) >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND DATE(closed_at) < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND closed_at <= NOW()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND open_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at > NOW()
SELECT open_at AS openAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM store WHERE id = #{storeId}

SELECT DISTINCT district FROM store WHERE region = #{region} AND district IS NOT NULL
AND city = #{city}
AND city IS NULL
ORDER BY district
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS count FROM store GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT id, created_at AS createdAt, region, name FROM store WHERE is_active = 1 AND open_at IS NULL AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > NOW()) AND name NOT LIKE '%테스트%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
